columns.mechanism: settlement mechanism: current (marginal +/- alpha) or new2026 (volume-weighted aFRR/mFRR)
columns.policy: price_taking_threshold (ThresholdStrategy replicated across the fleet, herding), impact_aware_threshold (internalises its own impact; same signal and bands), or strat:<name> (another agent's published price-taking ledger re-settled for the fleet)
columns.fleet_mw: fleet size Q in MW (Q / unit power identical batteries following the policy)
columns.eur_per_mw_year: net P&L (imbalance revenue - degradation) per MW of fleet per year
columns.overshoot_share: share of active quarter-hours where the fleet deviation is opposite to SI and larger than |SI| (the sign of SI flips)
columns.overshoot_qh_share: same, as a share of all quarter-hours
columns.harmful_share: share of active quarter-hours where |SI + q| > |SI| (fleet made the imbalance worse)

settings.price_taking_policy: ThresholdStrategy(mode='price', signal=running QH price of the mechanism, bands = 0.25 / 0.75 quantiles of the last 14 days of published prices, min spread 20 EUR/MWh)
settings.impact_aware_policy: ImpactAwareThresholdStrategy (same signal and bands; maximises q (P(q) - band))
settings.strat_policies: strat:<name> rows: Agent STRAT's published price-taking QH ledgers (reports/ledgers/realtime_*.parquet) re-settled at the counterfactual price of a fleet of Q MW (_1h = 1 MW / 1 MWh battery)
settings.impact_operator: fitted on the evaluation window itself. current: Elia's exact rule (neutral band |SI| < 25 MW, MIP / MDP bounded by FLOOR / CAP, alpha = tariff x price factor at the counterfactual SI of this and the previous quarter-hour), MIP / MDP first-difference volume curves, activation pass-through; new2026: NewWeightedMechanism2026 with aFRR / mFRR price curves and published weights (pro-rata)

notes: Prices respond to the fleet through the fitted impact operators (euroflex_bess_lab.realtime.impact); see reports/impact.md for the fit periods, validation errors and approximations.
Open-loop signals: the fleet's running signal does not contain its own deviation (worst case for the price taker); see the closed-loop multi-fleet results in reports/impact.md.
No look-ahead: strategies only use rows visible under the publication model.
